title: TechnicalCondition
description: A closed-allowlist grammar for expressing technical preconditions and postconditions. Supports logical composition (all/any/not) and a fixed set of predicate types. No domain arithmetic, relational operators, or executable code is permitted. Depth limit is enforced by the validator at runtime, not expressed in the schema itself.
$comment: Depth limit is enforced by the validator, not the schema.

Condition.title: Condition
Condition.$comment: Depth limit is enforced by the validator, not the schema.

AllCondition.title: AllCondition
AllCondition.description: Logical conjunction: all child conditions must be true.

all.description: One or more conditions that must all evaluate to true.

AnyCondition.title: AnyCondition
AnyCondition.description: Logical disjunction: at least one child condition must be true.

any.description: One or more conditions of which at least one must evaluate to true.

NotCondition.title: NotCondition
NotCondition.description: Logical negation: the child condition must be false.

not.description: The condition whose result is negated.

PredicateCondition.title: PredicateCondition
PredicateCondition.description: A leaf condition that tests a specific observable fact. The allowed predicate types form a closed allowlist; no arithmetic, relational expressions, or executable code may appear here.

StateEqualsCondition.title: StateEqualsCondition
StateEqualsCondition.description: Tests that a named state variable equals a specific string value.

target.description: The name of the state variable to test.

value.description: The expected string value of the state variable.

ElementVisibleCondition.title: ElementVisibleCondition
ElementVisibleCondition.description: Tests that the UI element identified by selectorRef is visible in the current session.

selectorRef.description: The logical name of the target selector (must appear in the script's TargetMap).

ElementEnabledCondition.title: ElementEnabledCondition
ElementEnabledCondition.description: Tests that the UI element identified by selectorRef is enabled (not disabled or read-only).

selectorRef.description: The logical name of the target selector (must appear in the script's TargetMap).

ElementExistsCondition.title: ElementExistsCondition
ElementExistsCondition.description: Tests that the UI element identified by selectorRef exists in the DOM or accessibility tree, regardless of visibility.

selectorRef.description: The logical name of the target selector (must appear in the script's TargetMap).

ElementTextEqualsCondition.title: ElementTextEqualsCondition
ElementTextEqualsCondition.description: Tests that the visible text content of the UI element identified by selectorRef equals the given value.

selectorRef.description: The logical name of the target selector (must appear in the script's TargetMap).

value.description: The expected text content of the element.

ApiOutcomeCategoryEqualsCondition.title: ApiOutcomeCategoryEqualsCondition
ApiOutcomeCategoryEqualsCondition.description: Tests that the outcome category of the most recent service call equals the given value. Uses the ServiceOutcome enumeration mapped to uppercase underscore form.

ApiActionCodeEqualsCondition.title: ApiActionCodeEqualsCondition
ApiActionCodeEqualsCondition.description: Tests that the action code returned by the most recent service call equals the given stable string code.

value.description: The expected action code string returned by the service.

CommandExitCodeEqualsCondition.title: CommandExitCodeEqualsCondition
CommandExitCodeEqualsCondition.description: Tests that the exit code of the most recently completed command step equals the given integer value.

CommandOutputContainsCondition.title: CommandOutputContainsCondition
CommandOutputContainsCondition.description: Tests that the stdout output of the most recently completed command step contains the given literal substring.

value.description: The literal substring to search for in the command's stdout output.

VariableIsSetCondition.title: VariableIsSetCondition
VariableIsSetCondition.description: Tests that the named script variable has been assigned a value (i.e., is not uninitialized). See C1 decision: an uninitialized var is a distinct state from null.

varName.description: The name of the declared script variable to test (must appear in the script's vars map).
